passage: I'm Lakshmi, and last month our school cricket team lost the final by two runs. I sat on the boundary rope and cried into my knees; my throat felt tight. I had cared so much. After a while I wiped my face, walked over to Sangeeta, the other captain, and said, "Well played." She hugged me quickly. On the way home I thought about how slow I am running between the wickets. I didn't throw my bat or blame the umpire, though for one minute I wanted to. Next week I will practise my running.

qa.q: By how many runs did Lakshmi's team lose the final?
What was Lakshmi feeling as she sat crying on the boundary rope?
qa.a: Crushed: Lakshmi had cared so much, and the tight throat shows it.

qa.q: How might Sangeeta have felt when Lakshmi said "Well played"?
qa.a: Probably appreciated, since she hugged Lakshmi quickly.

grounding: A child loses the final and is crushed, cries, congratulates the winners and decides what to practise.
